## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior and affected source-to-RNA boundary.

## Architecture impact

- Applicable [charter](https://github.com/logannye/biocompiler/blob/main/docs/architecture-charter.md) IDs (AC-01–AC-09), or why this is documentation/tooling only:
- Affected [capability matrix](https://github.com/logannye/biocompiler/blob/main/docs/capability-matrix.md) rows: changed boundaries, or why they remain unchanged:
- Preserved source obligations, assumptions and compatibility; unresolved claims or linked ADR if applicable:

## Validation

State the exact checks and scope exercised, the independent positive/adversarial
expectations for changed behavior, and what remains unvalidated. Link native or
release evidence by revision/run/attempt when applicable. A documentation check
does not establish compiler, biological or release acceptance.

Review using [the lightweight criteria](https://github.com/logannye/biocompiler/blob/main/docs/architecture-review.md).
